questions.q: Why did the party sit down at the top of the slope?
choices: To recover from the alarm and rest Silver and the sick
To count out the gold coins they had found on the way
To wait for the doctor to come and meet them as agreed
To hide in the grass from Ben Gunn and his musket
questions.evidence: partly to rest Silver and the sick folk

questions.q: How many "tall trees" did Silver find in about the right line from Skeleton Island?
choices: Three
One
Six
Ten

questions.q: What song suddenly came from the trees?
choices: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest
God save the King, sung very slowly
Pieces of eight, pieces of eight
A hymn out of Dick's little Bible
questions.evidence: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest

questions.q: How did the pirates react when they heard the voice singing?
choices: They went pale with terror, and Morgan grovelled
They laughed and joined in, singing along loudly
They fired their muskets wildly into the trees
They ignored it and kept walking toward the tree

questions.q: Why did the words "Fetch aft the rum, Darby!" terrify the pirates even more?
choices: They were Flint's last words
They were Silver's favourite saying
Darby was the name of their old ship
They meant all of the rum was gone

questions.q: What does Silver's speech about "seven hundred thousand pound" show about him?
choices: His greed was stronger than his fear
He did not believe in the treasure
He wanted to give up and go home
He was more afraid of the dead
questions.evidence: I'll not be beat by man or devil

questions.q: What reasoning did Silver use to prove the voice was not a spirit?
choices: A spirit would not have an echo
Spirits only come out at midnight
Spirits cannot sing sea songs
Flint never knew that song
questions.evidence: what's he doing with an echo to him

questions.q: Whose voice did Silver decide it really was?
choices: Ben Gunn's
Captain Flint's
Dick Johnson's
Doctor Livesey's

questions.q: Why did the pirates quickly lose their fear once they decided the voice was Ben Gunn's?
choices: Nobody cared about Ben Gunn, dead or alive
Ben Gunn had always been their good friend
Ben Gunn had no gun or weapon of any kind
Ben Gunn had already left the island by boat
questions.evidence: dead or alive, nobody minds him

questions.q: What was happening to Dick as they walked on?
choices: He was falling sick with the fever
He kept finding gold coins on the path
He was growing braver with every step
He wandered off and got lost in the trees

questions.q: How was the third tall tree different from the first two?
choices: It was the right one, a giant nearly two hundred feet tall
It had been chopped down and lay rotting on the ground
It was the smallest and youngest of the three trees
It had a second skeleton lying in the shade beneath it
questions.evidence: The third rose nearly two hundred feet into the air

questions.q: What did Jim believe Silver planned to do once he had the gold?
choices: Seize the ship at night, kill the honest men and sail away
Keep his promise to the doctor and give himself up quietly
Share the gold fairly with Jim as a reward for his help
Hand all of the treasure over to the squire for a pardon
questions.evidence: cut every honest throat about that island

questions.q: As the gold grew near, Silver's "nostrils stood out and quivered." What does this show?
choices: He was greedy and excited
He had caught a bad cold
He was nearly falling asleep
He was calm and relaxed
questions.evidence: his nostrils stood out and quivered

questions.q: What did the treasure hunters find when they reached the spot under the tree?
choices: An old dug-out pit with broken boards and no treasure
A great wooden chest packed full of gold coins
Ben Gunn fast asleep in the shade of the tree
Flint's ghost standing over the open grave
questions.evidence: Before us was a great excavation

questions.q: What name was branded on one of the boards in the pit?
choices: WALRUS
HISPANIOLA
FLINT
ADMIRAL BENBOW

questions.q: What is the big surprise at the end of this chapter?
choices: The treasure has already been dug up and taken
The pirates find far more gold than they expected
Silver is shot dead from the trees by Ben Gunn
Jim slips away and discovers the treasure alone
questions.evidence: the seven hundred thousand pounds were gone!
